text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne, a passionate and hard-working full-stack developer with 7 years of experience building responsive web apps and automated user flows.

I recently built a ticket shop with interactive seat maps for an events client using Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Stripe. It held seats for 8 minutes during payment and helped sell 18k tickets on opening night with zero double-booked seats.

Your project is a strong fit for my background in React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, and Stripe integrations. I can help build the draw system, split deposits into wallet balances, automate email/SMS responses, and set up membership credit handling in a clean, reliable way.

How do you want the draw, wallet split, and prize redemption rules to work in the first version?
